name: kumitate (CircleCI-compatible pipeline planning)
description: Streamable HTTP MCP server for the kumitate itonami dapp, a native Kotoba program built only with Amu selfhost: checks a CircleCI config.yml (2.1) with named refusals, computes the processed pipeline (parameters, executors, commands, when/unless, matrix, branch/tag and expression filters, the requires DAG with levels and parallelism), writes the config-process YAML and the CircleCI API v2 Pipeline/Workflow/Job shapes, lists each job's steps for running them yourself, and summarizes run records and JUnit reports (failed, flaky and slow jobs and tests). Pure tools over the passed text: no orb or function is fetched, nothing is sent to circleci.com or a VCS, no job is run and nothing is stored.
author: cloud-itonami
